caption: The drawing depicts a single goblet-shaped object placed centrally on a plain background. The goblet consists of a large, rounded bowl with a narrow neck that transitions into a flared base. The bowl section features decorative patterns, including circular medallions filled with botanical and floral motifs, a grid-like diamond pattern near the top, and a band with repeated triangular designs. The color palette used is primarily shades of gray, black, and white, giving the object a metallic or ceramic appearance with highlights and shadows indicating light reflection. The base is oval with additional small oval decorations around its edge, and the stem appears to have an organic, flowing design. The background is an unadorned, light beige color with slight variations around the edges. The artist's signature, "White," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Mirrored Glass Vase
